[Intro]

[Verse 1]
[Am]Waking up is har-
der
[F]than it seems,
[G]Wandering through these
empty rooms Of
[F]dusty books and
quiet dreams.
[Am]Pictures on the man-
tle,
[F]Speak your name
[G]Softly like for-
gotten tunes, Just
[F]outside the
sound of pain.

[Chorus]
[Am]Weren't we like a
pair of thieves,
[C]With tumbled locks and
broken codes.
[Dm]You can not take
that from me,
[E7]My small reprieves; your
heart of gold.
[Am]Weren't we like a
battlefield,
[C]Locked inside a
holy war.
[Dm]Your love in my due
diligence
[E7]The only thing worth
fighting for.

[Interlude]
[Am]
[F]
[G]
[F]

[Verse 2]
[Am]Change will come
to those who
[F]have no fear,
[G]But I'm not her; you
never were
[F]The kind who kept a
rulebook near.
[Am]What I said was
never
[F]what I meant.
[G]And now you've seen my
world in flames My
[F]shadow songs, my
deep regret.

[Chorus]
[Am]Weren't we like a
pair of thieves,
[C]With tumbled locks and
broken codes.
[Dm]You can not take
that from me, My
[E7]small reprieves, your
heart of gold.
[Am]Weren't we like a
battlefield,
[C]Locked inside a
holy war.
[Dm]Your love in my due
diligence
[E7]The only thing worth
fighting for,
